These HTML files are generated by the original ProseMirror DOMSerializer with
jsdom, kept as a development-only reference in ../dom-html.ts. The renderer
under test is never used to generate expected output.

From frontend/docweave, run:

    npm run test:goldens:generate

Review the golden diff before accepting a change. Normal tests never rewrite
these files. html-golden.test.ts checks exact output in Node without a global
DOM; html-reference.test.ts checks that the checked-in output still matches
ProseMirror's DOM renderer and the current output schema.

Inputs are defined in ../html-cases.ts: representative orders, escaping,
formatting transitions, empty clauses, headings, and twelve deterministic stress
seeds with mixed formatting, facts, edits, multiple paragraphs, nested lists and
non-default numbering. Each input has plain and change-highlighted output.
